subject: Matemática
description_pt: Quantificar e estabelecer relações entre o número de vértices, faces e arestas de prismas e pirâmides, em função do seu polígono da base, para resolver problemas e desenvolver a percepção espacial.

components.description_pt: Contar e registrar os vértices, faces e arestas de prismas e pirâmides
components.description_en: Count and record the vertices, faces, and edges of prisms and pyramids
components.cc_component_description: Identify the shape of a cross-section of a three-dimensional object, including prisms, pyramids, cylinders, cones, and spheres

components.description_pt: Estabelecer relacionamentos entre o número de vértices, faces e arestas de um prisma em função de seu polígono da base
components.description_en: Establish relationships among the number of vertices, faces, and edges of a prism as a function of its base polygon

components.description_pt: Resolver problemas usando os relacionamentos entre vértices, faces e arestas de prismas e pirâmides
components.description_en: Solve problems using the relationships among vertices, faces, and edges of prisms and pyramids
components.cc_component_description: Solve mathematical problems using nets to find the surface area of three-dimensional figures

cc_matches.description: Identify the shapes of two-dimensional cross-sections of three-dimensional objects, and identify three-dimensional objects generated by rotations of two-dimensional objects.

Represent three-dimensional figures using nets made up of rectangles and triangles, and use the nets to find the surface area of these figures. Apply these techniques in the context of solving real-world and mathematical problems.
